name: Rubik's x Disney Cubers 3x3 (Mickey Mouse)
description: Twist, turn, and show off your moves in a brand-new way with the Mickey Mouse Disney Cuber. It's the iconic 3x3 Rubik's Cube you love, with a character twist and a new way to display. Once solved, attach Mickey's ears and character head to the included body and stand to showcase your fandom with pride.
